## ✨ What's new in 0.2.6

### 🖥️ Built-in Remote Desktop signs in reliably
- Windows 11 could refuse the sign-in with *"wrong user name or password"* although Windows App got in with the very same credentials. The RDP engine is now built from current [IronRDP](https://github.com/Devolutions/IronRDP) sources, with an up-to-date NTLM/CredSSP implementation, to address this. If it still happens to you, use **Open in system client** and let us know.
- A refused sign-in now always asks for the password again, instead of showing a technical error such as *"not enough bytes"*.
- The password field of an RDP host now says what it does: the saved password is used by the built-in client; the system client (Windows App / Remote Desktop Connection) asks for it itself.

### 🍎 macOS: connecting to computers on your network
- Since macOS 15, apps need the **Local Network** permission to reach addresses like `192.168.x.x`. Terminyxx now asks for it properly.
- If a connection fails with *"no route to host"*, the message now tells you where to turn the permission on: **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Local Network**.

### 🔐 Sturdier tunnels
- A tunnel forwards at most **256 connections** at a time, so a misbehaving program can't make Terminyxx use unbounded memory.
- Opening a forwarded connection gives up after **15 seconds** instead of waiting forever on a server that doesn't answer.
- Stopping a tunnel now closes **every** connection it carries, including SOCKS connections that used to stay open.

### 🧭 Small UI cleanups
- The **+** button in the title bar is now a **🏠 Home** button: it always took you back to the start screen, not to a new tab.
- The collapsed sidebar no longer has a second "expand" button; use the sidebar toggle in the title bar or `Ctrl+Shift+B`.
- Thanks to [@Xstrwe](https://github.com/Xstrwe) for the contribution (#1)!

### Good to know
- **RDP sign-in with a Microsoft account:** use the account's password, not your Windows Hello PIN. Enter the user name as `COMPUTER\user` (as in Windows App) or as the account's email address, and leave **Domain** empty.
- After updating on macOS, check that Terminyxx is still allowed under **Local Network**; an app update can reset the permission.

### 🛠 Under the hood
- `golang.org/x/crypto` 0.54 → 0.59 (with `x/net`, `x/sys`, `x/text`); Go 1.26.
- The IronRDP web packages are built from source and vendored in `frontend/vendor/ironrdp`, with a reproducible `build.sh`.
